sections.Profile:
The "Colors" pinball machine, released by Williams Manufacturing Company on November 5, 1954, is a single-player electro-mechanical game designed by Harry Williams, with artwork by George Molentin.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1954
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Travel, Women, Wood Rail, Swimming, Pool (Billiards), Original Theme, Cruise ship, Recreation
